key_insight: Topo-Spectral Percolation Descriptors (TSPD) can infer ion-transport mechanism and dimensionality directly from a single static crystal structure by combining barrier-threshold percolation with graph spectral analysis.
engineering_relevance: This enables rapid, calibration-free screening of solid-state ionic materials to identify pathway-limited transport and bottleneck atoms before expensive AIMD or experiments.
method: Builds a periodic migration network from the crystal structure.
Computes physics-based edge barriers for ionic jumps.
Analyzes percolation topology and the barrier-weighted graph Laplacian spectrum to classify transport pathways.
evidence_signal: The authors validated TSPD on eight materials against AIMD ion densities and neutron diffraction, and it reproduced the established 1D-to-3D transport mechanisms in every case.
watch_item: TSPD is most informative for pathway-limited, direction-dependent transport and may be less definitive for strongly cooperative or nearly isotropic ion motion.
paper_title: Topo-Spectral Percolation Descriptors for Mechanistic Ion Transport Pathways from Static Crystal Structures
